Codebase review 2026-10-05 on main 3b2211a7bba7fb5699bd7fef3f9bb078bb6866a8. Classification: unimplemented.

There are typed text identifiers and message helpers, but the ticket’s requested ResourceBundle-based cross-built localization, desktop literal lint, shared confound sentence, plural handling, and locale number/minus tests are not established. The board itself classifies this post-MVP, which is a priority decision rather than implementation evidence. Keep it open as post-MVP; implement the bundle/formatting architecture before treating existing English message identifiers as internationalisation readiness.

Evidence:
- studio/app/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/app/text/TrialText.scala:51
- docs/studio/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md:317

Remaining / next action: Implement ResourceBundles, lint, plural/number formatting, and named tests.

Disposition: Keep open.
